court: Delhi District Court (Additional District Judge, West), Tis Hazari
sourceTitle: Civil Suit No. 08/14, ex parte judgment of 18 September 2014
summary: A sole-proprietorship print and design business (offset printing, graphic and website design) sued over printed materials supplied to the company in 2009-10. The court decreed Rs 19,93,744 with 9% interest and costs against the company and its directors, jointly. Ex parte: the defendants did not appear. The claim was for printed goods, not design fees. Appeal status not checked.
